environment.measurement_protocol: runtime: perf_counter around fit with no tracemalloc/wrappers; memory: separate tracemalloc fit with no wrappers; diagnostics: separate fit with neighbor/iteration wrappers
environment.memory_measurement: tracemalloc peak Python-traced memory; not total native/process RSS

measurement_protocol.time: repeated fit runs with perf_counter; tracemalloc off; no instrumentation wrappers
measurement_protocol.memory: one separate fit run with tracemalloc; no instrumentation wrappers
measurement_protocol.diagnostics: one separate fit run with wrappers for neighbor and iteration statistics; its elapsed time is not used

note: tracemalloc peak is Python-traced memory, not complete process RSS. Bandwidth quantile defaults to 0.1; inspect median_n_clusters in the report.
